dialogues.speaker: "Fantasy Institute"
dialogues.text: (This seems to be a literary work of fiction.)

dialogues.speaker: "Fantasy Institute"
dialogues.text: (In this book, the entire Fontaine Research Institute was transported to a fantasy world, and many researchers go on adventures together in this other world.)

dialogues.speaker: "Fantasy Institute"
dialogues.text: (There is a note stuck at the end of the text, with the following comments written on it:)

dialogues.speaker: "Fantasy Institute"
dialogues.text: ("Why do I still have to carry mechanisms and fight monsters even in another world? How is this any different from real life?")

dialogues.speaker: "Fantasy Institute"
dialogues.text: ("Is this what counts for popular novels within Institute circles? You might as well write one in which Mr. Edwin travels to another world with his Arkhium.")

dialogues.speaker: "Fantasy Institute"
dialogues.text: ("Please refrain from placing novels inside the Materials Office. Also, Mr. Edwin has stated that he has no interest in traveling to other worlds.")
